title: Zero observed loss does not imply zero true crossflow
statement: With each inlet/outlet absolute flow error<=e and observed min>e, true diverted fraction is at most max(0,min-mout+2e)/(min-e). Equal5ml/min readings at a1% gate require e<=5/201 ml/min as a sufficient installed-error condition. This is introduced metrology, not an acquired sensor. Ideal Poiseuille scaling supplies no real tube, molecular-diffusion/carryover guarantee, proof-pressure strength or future life.
